source: Record events only; NTSB report AAR-75-13 provided no FDR digitisation

markers.label: Pitot heads ice over at 16,000 ft; indicated airspeed begins to rise erroneously
Crew raise nose and reduce power, believing airplane is accelerating
Overspeed warning sounds at 24,800 ft; indicated airspeed 405 knots; crew pull nose up further
Stick shaker activates and airplane buffets; crew misinterpret as Mach buffet
Airplane stalls at 24,800 ft in nose-high attitude; rolls into descending spiral to the right
Descent rate exceeds 15,000 fpm in unrecovered spiral dive
Aircraft strikes wooded terrain in Harriman State Park; destroyed; all three crew killed
